items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: I hope I know you might have seen Ed Butterson around there. He's a rock and roll. Mr. Boo. Oh I heard of him.

ctx.x: I was about to say. But then some kind of humbug George Daniel and the man had a George Quick. So I had to get him a piano player. So I got him a piano player. And we used to play all kind of type of music. So one night, I hope I know you might have seen Ed Butterson around there. He's a rock and roll. Mr. Boo. Oh I heard of him. He was a Betty Boo. Freddie Boo or Betty Boo. I don't know anyway. He came down there. Him and his drummer. Well, he asked. The piano player could he play a number. Told him yeah. Drum…
I was wondering how that worked. I'd just like one more question. Something that struck my mind a little earlier, you were talking about the San Suu Ksi Hall.
